title: Collaborate on artifacts in Claude
format_note: Narrated screen walkthrough of one shared-doc scenario, from prompt to share dialog to comments to tracker, with a short title card and Claude Academy end card.
one_thing: Claude artifacts are now shared documents your team edits together, and teammates can @Claude from a comment to change them.

transcript.voice_style: Calm instructional narrator, second person, present tense, reads prompts aloud as they are typed on screen.
transcript.script_shape: Promise line over the finished UI, then a title card, then step-by-step: prompt, doc, share, comment, tracker, roles, link, comment-to-edit, library, summary question.

structure.frame0: Poster of the product itself: four overlapping avatars (K, Z, J, S), a comment icon and a black Share button, centred on cream. Subject present at t=0 (f0001.jpg).
structure.first_3s: Avatar row fills in one by one, the comment button becomes a '2' counter by t=1.0s, then the frame zooms out into the doc while narration states the promise.

beats.what: Promise over a live shared doc: avatar row, cursors with name flags, comment popover, narration says anyone can edit and ask Claude for updates.
Blue title card 'Collaborating on Claude Artifacts' inside a selection box with a cursor; card shrinks away.
Artifact type chips Docs, Slides, Design, Motion, Dashboard stagger in; a coral starburst arcs across them and into the chat home.
Prompt typed into a 'Let's noodle, Sylvia' composer; connectors menu toggles Slack on; whole prompt visible at t=38s.
Doc appears beside chat; Share dialog adds Zoe, Josefina, Kyra and shows role menu Owner, Editor, Commenter, Viewer.
Teammate cursors edit live; @Claude comment 'schedule this with ENG' gets reply 'Booked for Wed, 10 AM in Room B.'
Follow-up prompt typed: 'Build a tracker from this doc'; tracker artifact appears with checkboxes and progress bar.
Color-coded status labels Overdue and Slipping added by a second prompt; share dialog now shows Contributor role.
Tracker opened in a browser tab at claude.ai/artifact/team-priorities-tracker; checkbox ticked, progress 1 of 13.
Kyra comments, Sylvia replies 'Good idea! Let's update.' and Claude changes the label, keeping owners and checks (7 of 13 done).
Artifacts tab with template row and recents.
Prompt 'What did the team get done this week?' answered with a checked list per person.

hero_moment.what: Claude answers a teammate's comment inside the doc with a booked room, shown with highlights on the affected lines (strips/window-38-72.615s.jpg).

ending.what: Three plain centred cards on cream: Claude logo, Claude Academy lockup, URL. No music swell or product shot.

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: One 117.3 s shot (73 % of runtime) carries the whole demo through zooms and typing; only 5 hard cuts exist, at 15.56, 18.48, 135.8, 145.6 and 153.99 s. Pace comes from typing and UI state changes, set by narration.

look.ground: Cream (f0001.jpg) and near-white for UI; a flat mid blue (#6B9AC8-like) backdrop behind the app window for the whole demo section.
look.accent_use: Coral is reserved for the Claude starburst and the send button; the blue backdrop is a constant frame, avatars carry the other colour.
look.type: Serif display for titles and greeting, serif body in docs, grotesque sans for UI chrome; title card pairs regular and bold weights of the same serif.
look.depth: Flat. Soft drop shadow on the app window and popovers; no parallax or 3D.

product_ui.camera_on_ui: Zooms into the prompt box, share dialog and comment popover so the active region fills the frame, then pulls back out to the full window (f0004.jpg, f0028.jpg, f0067.jpg).
product_ui.notes: Zoomed states are legible; the full-window views at f0025.jpg and f0073.jpg carry 8-10 px body text at 720p, which is below phone legibility. Narration carries what the small text says.

motion.text_entry: User prompts type out character by character with a caret (f0016.jpg to f0037.jpg); the title card is present on its first frame after a hard cut, with no typed entrance.
motion.ui_motion: Chips stagger in left to right with fade and slight vertical offset (f0010.jpg); a starburst arcs over them (strips/window-15-23.524s.jpg); name flags and comment popovers appear in place; checkbox ticks and progress fill.
motion.camera: Scale and pan zooms between full window and detail, with motion blur visible mid-move (f0073.jpg).
motion.eases: Not measured numerically; moves read as ease-out settles with no overshoot in strips/window-11-17.852s.jpg.

good.observation: Frame 0 is the product, not a logo: avatars, comment and Share button already assembled, and the promise follows immediately.
One continuous story with a single running example (the team priorities doc) so every feature is shown on data already seen; the tracker reuses the doc's rows.
Zoom to the active control before each action keeps small UI readable, then pull-back restores context.
Prompts are typed on screen while the narrator reads them, so voice and text carry the same words and the viewer reads nothing alone.
Palette discipline: coral only on the Claude mark and send button; a constant flat blue backdrop frames every app screen.
Named cursors with colour flags (Sylvia, Kyra, Josefina, Zoe) show collaboration without any caption.

weak.observation: Pace is slow for social: 117 s in one shot and 12 s static runs, no burst of cuts, hero moment not marked by sound.
Full-window views carry text around 8-10 px at 720p, unreadable at phone width.
Integrated loudness -15.8 LUFS is 1.8 LU below the -14 social target.

rule_candidates.rule: In a feature walkthrough, zoom until the active control fills at least half the frame width before it is used, then pull back; do not leave a full app window on screen for a read.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0028.jpg, f0067.jpg zoomed; f0025.jpg full window small

rule_candidates.rule: Open on the finished, most recognisable fragment of the product (here avatar row plus Share button) assembled inside 1.3 s, instead of a title.
A tutorial can run one shot for 70 percent or more of runtime if state changes in the UI occur at least every 2 s.
Reuse one sample dataset across every demo step so each new feature builds on rows the viewer has already read.
rule_candidates.evidence: Team priorities doc becomes tracker f0025.jpg to f0067.jpg

rule_candidates.rule: Type each prompt on screen at narration speed and let the voiceover read it; the line is never held after typing ends.
Seed collaboration with named, colour-flagged cursors; each person gets one colour used for cursor flag, avatar and task owner.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0004.jpg Sylvia, Kyra, Josefina, Zoe; f0061.jpg

rule_candidates.rule: End on plain centred cards of logo, brand lockup and URL at 6.8 % of frame height, each on cream; no product shot.
Delivery in a chapter film: hard cuts only at chapter edges, 5 cuts in 160 s, with zoom and in-shot state changes covering the rest.
